official_data_index.composition_caveat: The README lists pretraining components but does not prove that an unverified local concatenation is identical to the efold_train dataset used by the official training script.

official_loader.evidence: rouskinhf.upload_dataset uses private=True by default; the public mirror returns RepoNotFound. The dataset may be private or withdrawn, so unauthenticated recovery is not available.

conclusion: Official dataset identity, loader behavior and data-index commit are confirmed, but exact training sequences and the efold_train composition manifest are not publicly recovered. Do not substitute TR1c or another model's clean set. eFold raw 8x3 remains valid; own-training-union clean remains blocked pending author-authorized sequence recovery.
next_action: Recover efold_train or a verifiable composition manifest and all component sequences from Hugging Face or the official Drive, then build exact plus 80% identity clean splits and run 8 split x 3 evaluation.
